items.name: EU AI Act
items.description: Regulation on artificial intelligence — high-risk AI systems provisions (Chapters III–VI)

requirements.text: High-risk AI systems shall be developed using data sets that are relevant, representative, and free of errors for the intended purpose.
requirements.rationale: Data quality directly impacts AI system safety and fundamental rights compliance.

controls.description: Implement data quality assessment procedures before model training, documenting source, completeness, and bias analysis of training datasets.

requirements.text: Data governance and management procedures shall be implemented for high-risk AI systems.
requirements.rationale: Ongoing data governance ensures continued compliance throughout the system lifecycle.

controls.description: Establish a data governance board with documented procedures for data selection, validation, and ongoing monitoring.

requirements.text: High-risk AI systems shall achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout their life cycle.
requirements.rationale: System accuracy and robustness are essential for protecting fundamental rights.

controls.description: Establish and document accuracy thresholds for the intended purpose; perform ongoing testing against these thresholds.
Implement cybersecurity controls (access controls, encryption, intrusion detection) appropriate to the system's risk profile.

requirements.text: Providers shall design high-risk AI systems to enable natural persons to interpret the operation of the AI system.
requirements.rationale: Transparency enables users to make informed decisions about AI system outputs.

controls.description: Provide clear documentation on system capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases to all end users.

titles.text: Obligations of providers of high-risk AI systems

requirements.text: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall implement a post-market monitoring system.
requirements.rationale: Continuous monitoring ensures ongoing compliance after deployment.

controls.description: Deploy a post-market monitoring system collecting performance data, incident reports, and user feedback on an ongoing basis.
